name: kite
description: Kite: a self-custodied auto-rebalancing portfolio on NEAR. Orchestration scripts for the contract, worker and web app.

scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix worker && npm ci --prefix web
scripts.test: npm test --prefix worker && npm test --prefix web && cd contracts/vault && cargo test
scripts.check: npm run typecheck --prefix web && npm run lint --prefix web && npm run build --prefix web
